account-locked: An kulle asusu na ɗan lokaci saboda yawan gazawar ƙoƙarin shiga. Da fatan a sake gwadawa daga baya.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel na SuperAdmin ne kawai, a Yankin Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Da WeKan a cikin Weddy, Cloud Panel yana ba da yankuna masu yawa na WeKan daga sabar guda ɗaya, kowanne da nasa bayanan. A Yankin Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin yana sarrafa yankunan da CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Da maɓallin CloudFlare API, yankin da zonensa ke cikin asusunka na CloudFlare yana samun rikodin DNS mai proxy da takardar shaidar CloudFlare Origin. Sauran yankuna suna samun takardar shaidar Let's Encrypt. Ana adana maɓallin a kan sabar kuma ba za a sake nuna shi ba.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Babu maɓallin CloudFlare API da aka adana: kowane yanki yana samun takardar shaidar Let's Encrypt.
error-email-taken: An riga an ɗauki imel ɗin
error-ldap-login: An samu kuskure yayin ƙoƙarin shiga
error-notAuthorized: Ba ka da izinin ganin wannan shafi.
error-user-notCreated: Ba a ƙirƙiri wannan mai amfani ba
error-username-taken: An riga an ɗauki wannan sunan mai amfani
